description: DBTL - A020501 - Diga is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by spatialdata.provincia.lodi.it. Information layer of the Topographic Database of the Province of Lodi. A020501, Dam. Hydraulic work built along a watercourse. It is characterised by an identifier of the entire work, unique within the portion of territories detected to associate all the parts that are returned. The crowning is returned. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "DBTL — A020501 — Dam" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opere idraulich, lodi, open data, database toporgafico, opere di difesa e regimazione idraulica. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
